dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, Paimon's used to this already... But why has this become a problem that only the two of us can solve again?

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: Two? You didn't count Ararycan in. Bad Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Ararycan is Aranara, so you don't really count!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's not sure what's going on here. How about we go see Amadhiah about it?
